command: set -u; echo '===LOCAL==='; hostname; id -un; echo '===RESOLVE==='; getent hosts ai-core-node || true; echo '===SSH-CONFIG==='; ssh -G ai-core-node 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(hostname|user|port) ' | head -10 || true; echo '===SSH-PROBE==='; timeout 10 ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 ai-core-node 'printf "HOST="; hostname; printf "USER="; id -un; test -d /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual && echo AVATAR_ROOT=YES || echo AVATAR_ROOT=NO' 2>&1 || true
